data.creative: 72-hour countdown of what one pouch does to mice · 932407452929259
data.hook: One Sofyre pouch lands in your kitchen. You barely notice it, but every mouse inside your house notices within seconds.
data.desire: No droppings on the counter in the morning, no scratching at 3 a.m., kids eating without me checking every shelf
data.angle: Hidden enemy inside the walls: an hour-by-hour story of the scent reaching cavities no trap or exterminator can reach
data.belief_shift: from 'a pouch is a weak air freshener that stays where you put it' → to 'its vapor travels into every wall cavity and drives the whole colony out within days'
data.script_structure: Pouch drops on counter → 'here is what happens over the next 72 hours' → hour 1/12/24/48/72 oil-by-oil effects on the mouse → first visible change (no droppings) → day 3/7/10/14 life-back timeline → four oils at full concentration, 90 days → 59% off + B2G1 + 30-day guarantee, sells out → CTA
data.mechanism_reveal: Claim: four volatile oils travel as vapor into wall cavities; castor oil, cedarwood ('hits their nervous system, heart rate spikes'), peppermint ('floods the one sense a mouse lives by', erases pheromone trails) and cinnamon each act in turn so the mouse has 'no clean pocket of air' and leaves. 'The only pouch that stacks all four at the strength where a mouse physically can't override any of it.' Soften: say the mix of strong scents makes treated spaces unpleasant for mice; drop nervous-system and heart-rate language.
data.proof: No testimonials. Demo-style b-roll and AI x-ray mouse animations (organs, glowing lungs) as visual proof; red X over droppings; day-count timeline; PDP screenshot with Buy 2 Get 1 Free tile; 30-day guarantee mention.
data.cta: 'If the link below still works, grab it before this batch is gone.' 59% off plus buy two get one free, 30-day money-back guarantee, 'they sell out constantly'.
data.why_it_works: Interpretation of execution, not measured performance: The hour-by-hour countdown gives a slow-acting product a story with built-in suspense, and each time stamp is a reason to keep watching. The payoff is shown as everyday relief moments (counter, 3 a.m., kids' cereal) rather than a dead mouse.
data.transferable_move: Turn the product's invisible working time into a stamped countdown (hour 1, hour 12, day 3), one step per stamp, ending on the first everyday sign the buyer would notice. Soften: say what the owner sees (a clean counter, a quiet night), not what happens inside the pest's body.
data.opening_visual: Kitchen granite counter, white pouch landing with a puff of vapor; red/green text 'WHAT SOFYRE POUCHES DO TO MICE IN YOUR HOUSE' and caption 'One SoFyre pouch'.
data.transition_to_product: Product is in the first frame (pouch on counter, 0:00); the pack itself appears at 1:58 'that stacks' with a finger tapping the ingredient panel.
data.proof_placement: Animated 'inside the mouse' visuals follow each hour stamp (0:08–1:25); no-droppings X follows 'first change' (1:09); offer screenshot follows the ingredient recap (2:07).
data.transcript:
Automatic transcript (en) from the original ad audio (Whisper, run locally 2026-11-18). Recognition errors may remain in names; numbers and claims are the advertiser's.
[0.0–2.0] One Sofyre pouch lands in your kitchen.
[2.0–4.5] You barely notice it, but every mouse inside your house
[4.5–5.7] notices within seconds.
[5.7–8.0] Here's what happens over the next 72 hours.
[8.0–10.4] In the first few seconds, the four concentrated oils
[10.4–11.7] start releasing into the air.
[11.7–12.9] They don't stay in the kitchen.
[12.9–15.5] They spread into every crack, every gap, every cavity,
[15.5–16.7] where a mouse has been hiding.
[16.7–19.6] After one hour, the castor oil reaches the wall cavities.
[19.6–21.3] Because these oils are volatile, meaning
[21.3–23.1] they travel as vapor through air, they
[23.1–25.2] reach the tight spaces behind your drywall
[25.2–27.7] that no trap, no spray, and no exterminator
[27.7–28.9] can physically get to.
[28.9–31.5] Including the exact cavity where a colony has been nesting
[31.5–33.7] for months, every breath starts to feel wrong.
[33.7–36.1] There's no clean pocket of air left to fall back to.
[36.1–38.8] By hour 12, the cedar wood hits their nervous system,
[38.8–41.3] their heart rate spikes, every survival instinct
[41.3–42.3] fires at once.
[42.3–44.4] The wall cavity they've been living in for months,
[44.4–46.4] the one that felt completely safe yesterday,
[46.4–48.0] now feels like a death trap.
[48.0–48.9] They stop feeding.
[48.9–49.8] They start moving.
[49.8–53.7] By hour 24, the peppermint floods the one sense a mouse lives by.
[53.7–55.8] It navigates your entire house by scent,
[55.8–58.6] every route to food, every entry point, every path
[58.6–60.8] back to the nest is mapped by pheromone trails
[60.8–62.2] it laid down over weeks.
[62.2–64.1] Now it can't smell anything but the pouch.
[64.1–65.0] The map is gone.
[65.0–67.1] It's blind inside a house it used to own.
[67.1–68.8] This is where you notice the first change.
[68.8–70.6] No droppings on the counter in the morning.
[70.6–73.8] By hour 48, the cinnamon has turned every crack and cavity
[73.8–75.3] into air the mouse won't sit in.
[75.3–77.3] There's no clean corner left behind the walls,
[77.3–78.6] nowhere to fall back to.
[78.6–81.2] Nothing worth staying for, so it does the only thing left.
[81.2–83.4] It finds a gap and leaves your house entirely.
[83.4–85.4] By hour 72, the trails are buried.
[85.4–86.3] The routes are gone.
[86.3–88.5] The entry points that used to lead mice straight into your
[88.5–89.9] kitchen now smell like death.
[89.9–92.2] The colony that was breeding inside your walls is gone
[92.2–93.6] and has nothing to come back to.
[93.6–95.0] And that's from just one pouch.
[95.0–96.9] Imagine what a pouch in every room does
[96.9–97.9] to your entire house.
[97.9–100.0] Day three, the droppings stop completely.
[100.0–102.8] Day seven, the scratching at 3 a.m. goes silent.
[102.8–104.5] Day 10, you stop checking the counter
[104.5–105.5] every morning out of habit.
[105.5–107.8] Day 14, your kids eat cereal out of the box
[107.8–109.7] without you inspecting every shelf first.
[109.7–111.9] Not from poison, from the mice actually leaving.
[111.9–114.0] A few Sofyre pouches placed once.
[114.0–115.8] Castor oil, cedar wood, peppermint,
[115.8–117.5] and cinnamon at full concentration.
[117.5–119.6] The only pouch that stacks all four at the strength
[119.6–121.8] where a mouse physically can't override any of it.
[121.8–124.0] Each one holds for 90 straight days.
[124.0–127.2] Right now they're running 59% off plus buy two get one free
[127.2–129.0] with a 30 day money back guarantee.
[129.0–130.5] But they sell out constantly.
[130.5–132.0] If the link below still works,
[132.0–133.8] grab it before this batch is gone.
